title.zh: Base完成第三次主网升级，新增条件交易并扩展了B20资产功能
title.en: Base完成第三次主网升级，新增条件交易并扩展了B20资产功能

current_state.zh: Base completed its third mainnet upgrade, Cobalt, adding conditional Validity Transactions and expanding the B20 token standard with Composite Policies, an ERC-8056-aligned Schedule Multiplier, and seizeWithMemo, while outlining plans for 200ms block times, native smart accounts and gas sponsorship.
current_state.en: Base completed its third mainnet upgrade, Cobalt, adding conditional Validity Transactions and expanding the B20 token standard with Composite Policies, an ERC-8056-aligned Schedule Multiplier, and seizeWithMemo, while outlining plans for 200ms block times, native smart accounts and gas sponsorship.
